description:
Cast Rampant Growth using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year.
When Studious First-Year enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
